newsitem.title: MEXICO: New Mexican bank will only lend to women.
newsitem.headline: New Mexican bank will only lend to women.

text.p: With Mexican finance houses groaning under the weight of bad debts, a new bank here plans a different approach -- making women responsible for paying loans.

Banco Santa Fe will open in the central Mexican state of Guanajuato in the next few weeks lending money to local small businesses -- but the cash will go to the owner's wife, who will also be responsible for repaying the loan.
"In the banking system it has been confirmed that women are more responsible, better payers and worthy of credit," said state official Ricardo Alaniz.
Alaniz told reporters the new bank, which will start with capital of $20 million, was modeled on Bangladesh's Grammin Bank.
